capabilities: Scaffold a trip folder with section notes (flights, hotels, transportation, attractions, tickets, packing, documents) and a note per day
Create trips from a form with name, location and dates
List trips on a dashboard with countdowns and quick links to sections and days
Delete a trip folder with a confirmation that shows the file count
Write an AGENTS.md guardrail file for AI agents inside the trip folder
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that AGENTS.md is a request, not access control, and recommends deny rules in the agent's permission settings for hard guarantees.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to scaffold structured trip folders or see every trip in a vault grouped by happening now, upcoming and past.

relations.evidence: AGENTS.md tells an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex and other tools that read it) how to fill each note
Query them with Bases or Dataview if you like.

requires.name: an AI coding agent (e.g. Claude Code, Codex)

summary: Travel scaffolding plugin that creates a folder per trip with section and day notes, and lists all trips on a dashboard.
